serverInfo.name: finn-tannlege
serverInfo.title: Finn-tannlege — Norwegian dental clinic search
serverInfo.description: Find a dentist (tannlege), orthodontist (kjeveortoped) or emergency dentist (akutt tannlege) in Norway by place, county (fylke), specialty, Helfo direct-billing agreement or emergency care. Supports natural-language queries in Norwegian and English. Read-only: no booking, no payment and no dental advice.
